countries.name: Sweden
countries.method: No national census exists (federation says most walls are not club-linked). Bottom-up: chain branch counts (Klattercentret 8, Klatterverket 2+) plus city guides plus small-town directory hits (Vaxjo, Karlstad, Eskilstuna, Visby, Hoganas, Skovde); ~80 federation clubs of which perhaps half run a public bouldering-capable hall. Directories are thin: climbing-gyms.com 28, indoorclimbing.com 18, boulderinglist 15 (all undercount).
